quotes.text: For a selected commit in a fork, use `rebaseMode: "selected"`, then replay distinct `rev-list --ancestry-path` descendant paths and update their refs. `preserveSelectedParent: false` avoids stale parent-anchor branches; reject a descendant commit with different parents rather than guessing. [Task 2]
